title: Fiatlux: A Long-Horizon Benchmark for Humanoid Ladder Climbing and Light-Bulb Replacement
venue: arXiv 2026 · under review at IEEE ICRA 2027
summary: A 12-subtask benchmark in NVIDIA Isaac Lab in which a simulated Unitree G1 humanoid moves a ladder, climbs it and replaces a ceiling light bulb.
imageAlt: The G1 crouching beside an A-frame ladder and gripping it to move it under the ceiling fixture.
